@profileAddFriends.description: Card on the own profile page that opens Add Friends.

@profileBackgroundDelete.description: Red option in the background picture menu.

@profileBackgroundTitle.description: Title of the menu shown when the user taps their profile background (narrow, large bold text).

@profileChoosePinned.description: Option in the menu of a pinned friend: opens the list to choose which friends are pinned to the profile.

@profileCopyLink.description: Button on Share Profile that copies the profile link (half-width button with an icon: keep it short).

@profileImageFromGallery.description: Option in the profile / background picture menu.

@profileImageTakePhoto.description: Option in the profile / background picture menu: opens the camera.

@profileMyCapsules.description: Section title on the own profile page.

@profileMyFriends.description: Row under the pinned friends on the profile page: opens the friends list.

@profileNoFriends.description: Shown instead of the pinned friends on the profile page when the user has no friends.

@profilePictureDelete.description: Red option in the profile picture menu.

@profilePictureTitle.description: Title of the menu shown when the user taps their profile picture (narrow, large bold text).

profilePinnedHint: If you choose fewer than 3, random friends from your list will be shown

@profilePinnedHint.description: Explanation under the title of the pinned friends chooser.

profilePinnedLimit: You can only pin up to 3 friends

@profilePinnedLimit.description: Error when the user ticks a fourth pinned friend.

@profilePinnedTitle.description: Title of the sheet where the user picks the friends pinned to their profile.

@profileQrError.description: Shown in place of the QR code on Share Profile if it cannot be drawn.

@profileShare.description: Button on Share Profile that opens the system share sheet (half-width button with an icon: keep it short).

@profileShareHeading.description: Heading above the QR code on Share Profile.

profileShareHint: Others can scan this code with their camera or the app to add you as a friend

@profileShareHint.description: Blue info card at the bottom of Share Profile.

@profileShareMessage.description: Text passed to the system share sheet when sharing a profile (the user's own or a friend's).

@profileShareSubject.description: Subject passed to the system share sheet (used by e-mail apps) when sharing a profile.

profileShareSubtitle: Let others scan this QR code to add you as a friend

@profileShareSubtitle.description: Grey line under the heading on Share Profile.

@profileUpdating.description: Shown on the profile or background picture while it uploads or is deleted.

@profileViewProfile.description: Option in the menu of a pinned friend: opens that friend's profile.

@profileFriendsSection.description: Small title at the top of the friends card on the profile.

@profileNoFriendsAction.description: Under "You have no friends yet" on the profile: tap to open Add friends.

profileAboutPrompt: Add a few words about you

@profileAboutPrompt.description: On the own profile when there is no "about me" line yet; opens its editor.

@profilePinLimit.description: Shown when more friends are pinned than allowed.

@profileFriendsAll.description: Link on the profile's friends card to the whole friends list.

@profileQuickMessage.description: Quick action on a friend in the profile: open the chat.

@profileQuickCapsule.description: Quick action on a friend in the profile: send them a capsule.

@profilePin.description: Quick action: pin the friend at the start of the profile's friends.

@profileStatCapsules.description: Label under the number of the user's capsules on the profile.

@profileStatPlaces.description: Label under the number of places (about 5 km apart) with the user's capsules.

@profileStatTogether.description: Label under the number of capsules made with friends (co-authors).

@profileNewCapsule.description: Screen reader start of the new-capsule buttons on the profile ("New capsule: For friends").

@profileNewForFriends.description: Profile button: a new capsule for friends.

@profileNewForEveryone.description: Profile button: a new capsule for everyone.

@worldTitle.description: The world view (B7): a passport of the countries where the user left capsules.

worldDescription: Countries and towns of your capsules

@worldCountriesLabel.description: Under the number of countries in the passport and on the profile.

@worldTownsLabel.description: Under the number of towns in the passport and on the profile.

@worldCapsules.description: On a country stamp: capsules left there.

@worldFirst.description: On a country stamp: the month of the first capsule there ("Oct 2026").

worldEmpty: Leave a capsule somewhere new and its country gets a stamp here.
worldNote: Stamps come from capsules made since this update.

@worldNote.description: Footnote: older capsules have no country, so they are not in the passport.

@profileAddCover.description: On a profile postcard without a cover photo; opens the photo picker.

@profileCountries.description: On the profile postcard after followers and following: countries with the person's capsules.

@profileStampLabel.description: Screen reader label of a person's stamp (their photo as a postage stamp).

profilePostcardOpen: Pull down to see the whole photo

@profilePostcardOpen.description: Screen reader hint on the profile postcard: pulling down opens the cover photo.

@profilePlacesSection.description: Section title on a profile above the Places card (map and Passport).

@profileFriendPassport.description: Row on a friend's profile: opens their Passport (countries and towns of their capsules).

@profileCountriesTowns.description: Under a Passport row: the countries and the towns, each already worded ("7 countries", "15 towns").

@profileTowns.description: How many towns have someone's capsules.

@profileFriendCapsules.description: Section title on a friend's profile above their capsules.

@stampTitle.description: Title of the sheet where you choose your stamp's shape and colour (your photo as a postage stamp on your postcard).

stampSubtitle: How your photo sits on your postcard.

@stampChangePhoto.description: Button on the stamp sheet: pick another profile photo.

@stampShapeSoft.description: Stamp shape: no perforation, very round corners.

@stampShapeTicket.description: Stamp shape: two notches on the sides, like a pass.

@stampShapePolaroid.description: Stamp shape: an instant print with your name under the photo.

@stampColourPaper.description: A stamp colour: the cream of the passport pages.

@stampColourForest.description: A stamp colour: the dark green of the passport cover.

@stampColourAny.description: The last colour swatch (a rainbow); opens a picker for any colour. Also the title of that picker.

@stampColourRecent.description: Label before the colours picked recently in the Any colour picker.

@stampColourHex.description: Label of the field with the colour as #RRGGBB.

@stampPreview.description: Under the stamp in the Any colour picker.

stampSaveFailed: Your stamp could not be saved. Please try again.

@stampSaveFailed.description: Error after choosing a stamp shape or colour.

@stampDone.description: Button that closes the stamp sheet and keeps the choice.
